newsitem.title: USA: American Shared Hospital says to be acquired.
newsitem.headline: American Shared Hospital says to be acquired.

text.p: American Shared Hospital Services said on Wednesday it has signed a letter of intent to be acquired by US Diagnostic Inc for $2.25 a share in cash.
American Shared said it currently has 4,769,384 common shares and 2,226,266 options and warrants outstanding.
"As a major shareholder of American Shared, I wholeheartedly support the proposed sale to US Diagnostic," Ernest Bates, chief executive officer, said in a statement.
"I believe this (deal) is an excellent opportunity for our shareholders to obtain a fair price," he added.
The boards of both companies have approved general terms of the acquisition, subject to the execution of definitive agreements.
Completing the deal remains subject to satisfactory completion of due diligence by US Diagnostic, negotiating final terms and approval by regulators and shareholders, among other items.
American Shared said it hopes to consummate the acquisition in the first quarter of 1997.
